decision_inputs: observed snapshot and available forecast; future actual demand excluded

selection.objective: minimum closed-schedule TO1+TO2+TR1+TR2+TR3 resource cost among checked candidates
selection.economic_comparison_scope: same forecast; no waiting constraint or objective

waiting_constraints: peak first/next eligible train service gate
cost_policy: minimum checked maintenance resource cost with peak boarding constraints

solver.tail_demand_scope: no supplied forecast: fixed-clock maximum-gap coverage only
solver.demand_bound_scope: max supplied quarter rate times entire possible retained gap; terminal-clock nominal offset
solver.action_scope: temporary withdrawal and preserved same-site re-entry
solver.retained_clock_scope: all initial, executed, current and retained later SERVICE clocks remain exact
solver.preparation_scope: same-site return; depot inclusive release or siding physical reversal
solver.stabling_allocation_scope: candidate values use next quota slot; selected batch destinations and cost checked in replay

peak_waiting_proxy.scope: proposal-only crossing rate discount in weekday Moscow08-10/17-19 peak slots
peak_waiting_proxy.model: rate*(1-first_miss_limit); queue carryover and individual first misses not modeled

terminal_visits.scope: shared terminal visits include ENTRY and inbound trains; half-open intervals

audit.infrastructure_scope: assumed shared terminal TOTAL2/standby1; real layout unverified

future_cohort.scope: all turnstile arrivals in [start,end); platform waiting through saved end

peak_boarding_service.binding_scope: aggregate and each peak 15-minute platform-arrival cohort
peak_boarding_service.station_scope: descriptive; no separate station percentage gate
